title: Signed shift data for every integral pullback
statement:
theorem automorphismConstructibleStage_integral_shift_data
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    ∀ (Z W : Scheme.{u}) (g : Z ⟶ W),
      ∃ (c : (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E g).CommShift ℤ)
        (d : (integralDerivedPullback l E g).CommShift ℤ),
        IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftCoordinates l E g c ∧
          IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftDescent l E g c d

source.place: canonical shift clause of the Weil-structures paragraph

proof.text: Choose the strict finite pullback tower comparison and apply its signed mapping-cocone shift; the derived comparison transports the coordinates and descent equation.
